goodToKnow: Fortan means from now on, or from that point on in a narrative: Er lebte fortan in Wien. It's literary and formal, so in speech use ab jetzt or von nun an. It's built from fort (onward) and an, as in fortfahren (to carry on) and fortsetzen (to continue). A similar word is künftig (in the future). In legal texts, you'll see fortan used for new rules taking effect.
